page.overview:
Who is Fremont Family?

The Fremont Family comprises the relatives of Mia Fremont from The Man in Room 1280, the third story in Fazbear Frights #5: Bunny Call.

Mia Fremont is one of the main protagonists in The Man in Room 1280. She is a perky and energetic nurse who works at Hercules Hospital.

Lucas is Mia's younger cousin. Not much is known about him other than that he is a bit mischievous and was always up to no good.
